payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics and results achieved by the proposed approach in named entity classification tasks.

claims.text: The proposed model achieves a total F-1 score of 88% on the OntoNotes dataset and 53% on the Wiki(gold) dataset.
The model shows acceptable out-of-the-box performances for fine-grained datasets, with F-1 scores between 80-90% for various categories, except for time which has a score of 65%.
